revenue: SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_cents) for orders with status paid or shipped; divide by 100.0 for USD
average_order_value: Eligible revenue divided by distinct eligible order count; protect division by zero
historical_prices: Use order_items.unit_price_cents, never products.unit_price_cents, for order revenue
customers: Includes customers with no orders unless restricted
dates: ISO dates, UTC. Resolve relative dates using the supplied request reference date.
ambiguities: Best customer: ask revenue or order count
Bare after January 2024: clarify the boundary; after January 2024 ends is explicitly February 1 inclusive
state_storage: customers.state contains two-letter uppercase US state codes, never full state names
